h1: Custom Full Color Workwear for Your Team
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color workwear with logos. Perfect for teams and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Full color decoration lets you reproduce complex logos, photographs, and gradients on workwear with exceptional detail. Unlike single-color screen printing, full color processes like direct-to-garment or full-color embroidery capture every shade and nuance, making them ideal for marketing teams that need brand accuracy on polos, jackets, or aprons. This method works best on light-colored fabrics to maintain color vibrancy.
heroAltText: Custom full color workwear with detailed logo print on a polo shirt
